name: Hwang Sagwaui Yeonin
source:
"The god who wins her heart will be crowned the greatest of all."

I woke up in the Forest of Gods, my past a distant blur.
Guided by Hades, the enigmatic ikemen God of the Underworld,
I soon find myself inside a divine palace, surrounded by radiant ikemen gods.

But everything changes when the gods notice the golden inscription glowing on my collarbone:

[To the greatest god.]

This simple phrase throws the realm of the gods into chaos.
Who among them is truly the greatest?

Debates rage, egos clash, and celestial tensions rise—
until a bold challenge is proposed:

"Let her otome choice decide who deserves the title of the greatest god."

Now, four divine anime otome ikemen gods compete to win my heart, each offering love, devotion, and breathtaking romance in their own unique way.

Will my anime otome choices lead to eternal love, balance, or unexpected twists?
Inspired by Greek mythology’s golden apple, Golden Desire is an anime otome adventure where every choice shapes my divine fate!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.c20client]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
“赢得她心的神将被加冕为最伟大的神。”

我在众神之森中醒来，我的过去已变得遥远模糊。
在神秘的地狱之神哈迪斯的引导下，
很快我就发现自己置身于一座神圣的宫殿之中，周围都是光芒四射的艾克门诸神。

但当诸神注意到我锁骨上闪闪发光的金色铭文时，一切都改变了：

【献给最伟大的神。】简单的一句话，就让神界陷入了混乱。
他们之中谁才是真正最伟大的？

争论激烈，自我冲突，天上的紧张局势加剧——
直到提出大胆的挑战：

“就让她的乙女选择来决定谁配得上最伟大的神的称号吧。”

现在，四位神圣的动漫乙女男神竞相赢得我的心，每一位都以自己独特的方式提供爱、奉献和令人惊叹的浪漫。

我对动漫乙女的选择会带来永恒的爱情、平衡还是意想不到的曲折？
《黄金欲望》的灵感源自希腊神话中的金苹果，是一款动漫乙女冒险游戏，每一个选择都塑造着我神圣的命运！
